data.description:
## Context / Problem
Ticket refractive-conceptual-sunbear attributed the 2026-08-12/13 GitHub Actions runner
starvation (a Gerrit `Verified` pytest matrix queued ~2 hours) to tickets-branch pushes. That
premise is measurably wrong, so the contention it describes is still unaddressed.

## Findings (measured 2026-08-13, after change 1719 merged)
- The `tickets` branch is an ORPHAN branch with no `.github/` directory
  (`git ls-tree -r origin/tickets | grep '^\.github/'` -> 0 matches). GitHub evaluates
  workflow files AT THE PUSHED REF for push events, so a tickets push could never have
  started a run.
- `/actions/runs?branch=tickets` -> `total_count = 0` across the API's whole retention window.
- Branch/event distribution of every run created 2026-08-12..2026-08-13T09:20Z:
  `main|workflow_dispatch` 609, `main|schedule` 169, dependabot branches 26, `main|dynamic` 7,
  `tickets|push` ZERO.

The 609 `workflow_dispatch` runs on `main` are the Gerrit `Verified` lane itself
(`gerrit-verify.yaml` is dispatch-triggered, one dispatch per patchset). navapbc is on GitHub
Free — 20 concurrent jobs / 5 macOS, enforced PER ORGANIZATION and shared with every other
navapbc repo — and a single Verified run needs ~21 job slots. That is the real driver.

## Approach
Not yet decided; this ticket is the record of the finding, to be planned before it is claimed.
Candidate directions, none of them costed yet: reduce the job count of a single Verified run,
coalesce superseded patchset dispatches, or shed the macOS cell from the pre-merge lane and
carry it on the branch-health schedule instead. Any of these needs its own measurement pass
before it is proposed as the fix.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The per-run job-slot cost of the Verified lane and the observed queue depth during a
      burst are measured and recorded on this ticket, so a proposal can be judged against a
      number rather than a hunch.
- [ ] A remediation is chosen and planned (or the contention is explicitly accepted with a
      stated reason), reviewed via `rebar review-plan` before any code change is claimed.
data.title: Verified-lane dispatch volume, not tickets pushes, saturates the Actions pool
